verdict.rationale: Pricing is a fair axis for a voice AI calling platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents published per-minute or usage pricing, or any way to estimate cost per call. The only cost-related item is a community remark that the product 'gets expensive', which shows neither published rates nor estimation tooling.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing
